title: Lee Kong Chian Scholars' Programme (LKCSP)
funding: Full Tuition Fee Waiver + Living Allowance
program_type: Distinguished merit-based undergraduate scholarship for freshmen, donor-funded by the Lee Foundation
duration: Waiver of annual subsidised tuition fees for regular terms (semesters 1 and 2) for up to four years, alongside an annual living allowance.
description: The Lee Kong Chian Scholars' Programme is one of Singapore Management University's most prestigious undergraduate scholarships, made possible by a gift from the Lee Foundation, with up to 60 scholarships funded. It is open to full-time SMU first-year undergraduates of any nationality taking a single or double degree programme, and requires a second major or an equivalent breadth requirement, demonstrated leadership and communications skills, and a substantial record of co-curricular activity or community service. title: SUTD PhD President's Graduate Fellowship (PGF)
official_source: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD)
duration: The scholarship covers the applicable tuition fees for up to 4 years.
description: The SUTD PhD President's Graduate Fellowship is awarded by the Singapore University of Technology and Design to PhD candidates of all nationalities. It covers the applicable tuition fees for up to four years and pays a monthly stipend, with rates effective from 1 January 2026 of S$5,300 for Singapore Citizens, S$4,800 for Singapore Permanent Residents and S$4,300 for international students. Singapore Citizens additionally receive CPF contributions at the prevailing employer's contribution rate on top of the stipend. title: QUAD STEM Scholarship Scheme (ICCR)
program_type: Government of India fully funded undergraduate STEM scholarship under the ICCR Scholarship Programme
duration: The four-year B.Tech programme at the designated institute. ICCR provides scholarships only for structured courses of one year or more at UG, PG or Ph.D. level; research-course admission is provided only at Ph.D. level.
description: The Quad STEM Scholarship Scheme is offered under the ICCR Scholarship Programme for nationals of 32 QUAD-partner countries to pursue undergraduate B.Tech courses at eight designated Indian institutes, covering stipend, house rent allowance, contingent and thesis allowances, return airfare and tuition fees. It is administered through the A2A (Admission to Alumni) Portal and funded by the Ministry of External Affairs.

title: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Cultural Exchange Scholarship Scheme (ICCR)
program_type: Government of India scholarship under the ICCR Scholarship Programme for cultural exchange countries
duration: One academic year or more, matching the structured course applied for. ICCR norms restrict the maximum period of scholarship to five years for a Ph.D. course, plus a maximum of six months to defend the thesis or for the viva voce.
description: The Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Cultural Exchange Scholarship Scheme, formerly the Cultural Exchange Programme and Education Exchange Programme, is offered under the ICCR Scholarship Programme to nationals of 23 countries for undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral study at Indian universities and institutes in STEM and Non-STEM streams. It is administered through the A2A (Admission to Alumni) Portal and funded by ICCR.

official_source: UNESCO-TWAS and Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), India
program_type: Doctoral research fellowship tenable in CSIR laboratories and institutes in India
duration: Full-time fellowships up to a maximum of 4 years; sandwich fellowships from a minimum of 6 months up to a maximum decided by the host institute but no greater than 3 years
description: TWAS-CSIR Postgraduate Fellowships are tenable in CSIR research laboratories and institutes in India for a maximum period of four years.
